html:
A K-pop song and music video by the South Korean singer Psy, released in July 2012. In December 2012 it became the first video on YouTube to pass a billion views.

The song mocks the showy lifestyle of Gangnam, a rich district of Seoul south of the Han River. In the video Psy, in a sharp suit, does a dance like riding an invisible horse in stables, saunas and parking garages. People around the world copied the dance, from schools to politicians.

It showed how the internet let a song spread worldwide without radio or a Western label. It was a high point of the Korean Wave, the spread of Korean pop music, dramas and films since the late 1990s, which later carried BTS, the film Parasite and the series Squid Game to global audiences.
sum: A K-pop song and music video by the South Korean singer Psy, released in July 2012. In December 2012 it became the first video on YouTube to pass a billion views.
